messages:
maria: quick micro-poll — which editor keeps you sane during a long debug session? react with :thumbsup: for VSCode or :heart: for Neovim. (feel free to add a one-liner why)
ajay: :thumbsup: vscode — built-in debugger + extensions win for me.
sam_t: :heart: neovim — muscle memory + speed. i love having <leader>f for everything.
kelly_r: :thumbsup: vscode — remote containers, exact environment, saves me hours.
noah: :heart: neovim — but i use vscode for occasional GUI stuff. hybrid life.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: Poll results so far — VSCode: 2, Neovim: 2.
maria: tie breaker: shout out any must-have extension or plugin in one word?
ajay: live-share
sam_t: telescope
kelly_r: devcontainers
noah: treesitter
maria: ok next mini question — favorite keybinding to brag about? mine: `gd` for go-to-definition (neovim ninja move)
ajay: `cmd+shift+o` (vscode symbol search)
sam_t: leader+f for fuzzy in buffer
kelly_r: `ctrl+shift+p` (command palette forever)
noah: i once mapped `jj` to escape and felt like a wizard
maria: thanks party — results posted to #watercooler-stats tomorrow maybe :party_parrot:
